speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have a history of significant medical issues; to understand your current gait and limb ataxia, have you ever been diagnosed with multiple sclerosis or another neurological condition before?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That sounds concerning. To help narrow this down, has anyone noticed any changes in your vision, such as double vision or blind spots, or have you experienced sudden weakness on the right side of your body?
